text: There, the earth is the element of smell. It is of two kinds: eternal and non-eternal. The eternal is in the form of atoms; the non-eternal is in the form of products. It is further threefold, according to the distinction of body, sense organ, and object. The body is that of us and others. The sense organ is the smell-perceiving faculty, i.e., the olfactory sense, located at the tip of the nose. The object is clay, stone, and so on. || 9 ||
